title: Strange lights over the San Juan coal mine
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Strange lights over the San Juan coal mine, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: San Juan coal mine, New Mexico

tellings.quote: I also spoke to an Aztec local who has seen strange lights darting above the San Juan coal mine right by where he worked

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he spoke to a local man from Aztec, a town in New Mexico, who had seen strange lights darting above the San Juan coal mine, right by where the man worked. Michels brings it up while looking into claims of a crashed craft in that area. If true, it would suggest odd things are still being seen in the sky there.
